grammar.numbers: CAD dimension line drawn between two extension lines, the value counting up above it; a percentage is an arc traced round a protractor
grammar.comparisons: two stroke-drawn columns, dashed centre line, VS in a drawn circle, the takeaway in a drawn amber box
grammar.steps: numbered callouts: circle numerals drawn one by one on a dashed spine, a leader line out to each item
grammar.change: classic navy change card (MotionTrack), dropped to the top of the stage
grammar.trend: classic line graph (MotionTrack), dropped to the top of the stage
grammar.lenders: logo in a drawn detail-callout circle with a leader line to a neutral label
grammar.captionPosition: fixed annotation label box under the stage (bottom y 1300); English note at the foot of the safe band

skinAxes.cover: blueprint sheet, logo tile, title inside a drawn frame with dimension ticks
skinAxes.captions: white words in a thin outlined label box with amber corner ticks; keywords amber; English as an italic note under a dashed rule
skinAxes.framing: no footage and no person: pure line-art motion graphics on a navy blueprint sheet
skinAxes.transitions: every element traced on with stroke animation, fades out; chapters redraw the title block
skinAxes.texture: fine and major cyan grid panning slowly, sheet border and registration marks, a house elevation traced part by part while the stage is free
skinAxes.sound: voice + click sfx on callouts and columns
